rules.text: Most items may be returned within 30 days from the original purchase date with original receipt.
rules.quote: You may return most items within 30 days from the original purchase date with original receipt, provided that it is unused, uninstalled, and in its original packaging.
rules.reviewNote: The summary omits important conditions from the quote: items must be unused, uninstalled, and in original packaging. The summary is incomplete and could mislead consumers.

rules.text: Original receipt is required for returns within 30 days.
rules.quote: You may return most items within 30 days from the original purchase date with original receipt, provided that it is unused, uninstalled, and in its original packaging.
rules.reviewNote: The summary omits that returns are only accepted if the item is unused, uninstalled, and in original packaging, as stated in the quote.

rules.text: Gift Cards cannot be returned for any reason.
rules.quote: Gift Cards cannot be returned for any reason.

rules.text: Trading cards are final sale and cannot be returned or exchanged.
rules.quote: Trading cards are considered final sale. Returns or exchanges are not accepted.

rules.text: Clearance items are final sale and cannot be returned.
rules.reviewNote: The summary adds that clearance items cannot be returned, but the quote only says they are final sale. While this usually means no returns, the summary is slightly more explicit than the quote.

rules.text: Hazardous materials and products using hazardous materials cannot be returned.
rules.quote: Hazardous materials and products that use hazardous materials, such as flammable liquids or gasses cannot be returned.

rules.text: Local Ace store may charge a 15% restocking fee, minimum $20, for assembled items returned but not damaged or defective.
rules.quote: Your local Ace store may charge a re-stocking fee of 15%, minimum of $20, for an item that has been assembled and returned but is not damaged or defective.

rules.text: A $15 pickup fee may be charged for returning proper items that are not damaged or defective.
rules.quote: If you received the proper item that was not damaged or defective, you may be charged a $15 pickup fee.

rules.text: Refunds may take 3 to 5 business days to issue plus additional time for funds to be available.
rules.quote: It may take three to five business days to issue your refund. Once we issue your refund, it may take additional time for your funds to be made available in your account by your financial institution.

rules.text: Tinted paint orders are final and cannot be returned, refunded, or exchanged.
rules.quote: Tinted paint orders placed on acehardware.com are final and cannot be returned, refunded, or exchanged for a new color.
